svg.title: Riju compares three official records for one resident.
svg.desc: Postal, welfare and electoral forms sit in separate trays around Riju's terminal. The affected resident stays beside the desk while Ila, Vale and Cecil watch the comparison.
svg.text: Page 9, panel 1 · Eye-level wide shot across a ward service desk

text.tspan: The team places postal, welfare and electoral
versions of one life side by side.
